easy.def: A word that shows something belongs to us.

more.def: A word used to show that something belongs to or is connected with the speaker and others.
examples: Our class is going on a trip to the farm.
We picked apples from our own tree.
Our team practices every Tuesday after school.

easy.def: Away from the inside of a place.
examples: Let us go out to play.

more.def: Away from the inside of a place, or not at home or at work.
examples: The children ran out into the yard as soon as the rain stopped.
Mom is out shopping, but she will be back soon.
The turtle stuck its head out of its shell.
On sunny days, our class eats lunch outdoors.
The concert was held outdoors in the park.
He loves working outdoors on the farm.
